title: Chapter 195 Incomplete Report (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 195 Incomplete Report (Part 2)

Wang Shuo had the advantage of the terrain, and the skeleton archers were basically useless.

They were quickly scattered by the cavalry's charge.

The biggest advantage of the skeleton soldiers was that they were not affected by morale. Even if there was only one left, he would fight to the death.

As the battle continued, the ordinary skeleton soldiers were soon wiped out.

Only a few captains and centurions were left.

The skeleton captain was equivalent to an elite monster, and the centurion was equivalent to a bronze boss.

Wang Shuo saw that these skeleton officers were able to dodge arrows calmly.

He knew it was time for him to appear.

"Let's go down and meet them."

Wang Shuo checked the attributes of the skeleton centurion.

He felt that he could fight him alone.

It was just right to test his own strength.

At this time, his attack power had reached more than 200 points, and his defense power had also reached 200 points. It can be said that he was full of confidence.

Wang Shuo held a flaming spear, rode a warhorse, and rushed over quickly.

The spear tip, with great impact, went straight to the chest of the skeleton centurion.

This centurion was a sword and shield soldier.

He held a sword in one hand and a shield in the other.

Wang Shuo's charge was easily blocked by the opponent's shield.

The centurion's shield looked ordinary, but it could block Wang Shuo's golden flame spear.

This surprised Wang Shuo.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo decided to dismount and fight on foot.

As for Gong Zheng, Ayub and others, they dealt with other elite skeletons.

After a simple test, Wang Shuo decided to show his strongest strength.

"Iron Chain Binding" was launched.

The opponent was directly trapped in place.

The skeleton centurion became a living target, and Wang Shuo attacked him crazily.

After the restraints were released, the centurion finally had the opportunity to start counterattacking.

But the entire battle rhythm was completely controlled by Wang Shuo.

The battle lasted for more than ten minutes, and Wang Shuo went straight to Huanglong with one move and directly killed the skeleton centurion.

[You killed the Skeleton Centurion. ]

[You won the chess game. ]

Before Wang Shuo had time to collect the spoils, he was teleported out of the battlefield and returned to the command center.

"Finally free! I swear, I will never play chess again." The Skeleton Commander You Yong said to Wang Shuo with gratitude.

Wang Shuo heard his tone and seemed to have helped him a lot.

You Yong has been trapped in this place for thousands of years and has long hated the chess game he liked before his death.

This is also one of the reasons why the Skeleton Centurion who fought against Wang Shuo was so vulnerable.

As soon as the voice fell, You Yong's figure slowly dissipated, leaving behind a rotten armor and a rusty broken sword.

At the same time, in the center of the sand table, a fragment of a report floated.

Wang Shuo picked it up.

[Obtained the incomplete report (II), the progress of the side quest was 15%. 】

It says: "In early March, the skeleton soldiers began to attack the villagers of Pianqiao Village. The village chief asked for help from the town guards, but Xianhe Town did not send troops to rescue them."

At this time, another animation appeared in front of him.

In a desolate mountain, there is an altar of the dead, surrounded by a thick breath of death.

Every once in a while, a low-level skeleton soldier reorganized his body in the altar, simply moved his joints, and then walked to the side and stood still.

And next to him, there are hundreds of skeleton soldiers like him.

The scene changed, and dozens of skeleton soldiers appeared in Pianqiao Village.

Although these skeleton soldiers are similar to those Wang Shuo encountered in the ancient battlefield, they have no combat power, but they are still very dangerous to ordinary civilians.

And they hold knives in their hands and kill anyone they see.

The bodies of the killed civilians were directly transported back to the altar and transformed into skeleton soldiers again. And as the number of transformed skeleton soldiers increased, the altar continued to expand.

The entire Pianqiao Village only had a hundred or so people, mostly the elderly, women and children. There were only ten strong and young people, and they were no match for the skeleton soldiers.

Soon, the whole village was flooded with blood, and not even a single living chicken was left!

…
